title: New Capabilities
lede: Beyond the rearchitecture, 2.0 adds capabilities that weren't possible before.
body:
At a glance
  • Plugin SDK & external TTS API.
  • Composite engine and project backups.
  • Predictive progress and VCR playback.
  • Voice tags & icons.

Extensibility

A plugin SDK and an external TTS API. Wrap engines and drive Studio from your own tools. See Plugin SDK and TTS Gateway API.

Production features

  • Composite synthesis across engines in one chapter.
  • Project backups and disk-based recovery.
  • Predictive progress with ETAs, and VCR-style playback in the editor.

Voice library

Voices gain icons and tags, making a real, searchable library. See Voice Icons & Tags.

Coming with 2.0 — installable engines from GitLab, the Hugging Face voice library, and AI voice casting land as part of the 2.0 rollout.
